reasoning: This is a Kubernetes-aware gRPC service that acts as an Envoy external processor (ext_proc) for AI inference payload processing. Its primary function is to run as a gRPC server that intercepts and mutates inference request/response payloads (headers and body) flowing through an AI Gateway. It uses the llm-d Inference Payload Processor framework to load plugins that perform custom mutations. While it embeds Kubernetes controllers (using controller-runtime) to reconcile ExternalModel and ExternalProvider CRDs into HTTPRoute, Service, and related resources, its core identity is a running service — the payload processor — rather than a pure operator. It is deployed via Helm alongside an Istio EnvoyFilter that wires it into the gateway's ext_proc chain.
